import BusyBeaver.ZFC.@FINAL_NAMESPACE@
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Simulation
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.LogicalSeed246

/-!
Whole-tape identification of the rotation244 startup target with the calibrated
logical seed. This is a shape adapter for any configuration represented by
that target. The final theorem links it to the complete407931-step blank run
through the separately checked final bootstrap group.
The seed calibration is reused unchanged from LogicalSeed246. The target is
the complete finite zipper specified by the rotation244 delivery and the
bootstrap generator, including every spare block and the zero exterior.
Mira-Cult, Jeff Ketchersid, Andrew James Wade and the ProveIt reductions retain
the attribution of the imported source and machine proofs.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.BootstrapFrameRotation244

open FiniteZipper Permutation252Frame Rotation244Simulation

def spares : List Nat := List.replicate 167 1

theorem spares_nonempty : spares ≠ [] := by decide +kernel

theorem physical_seed :
    vregs LogicalSeed246.initial.registers = [0, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0] := by
  decide +kernel

theorem seed_tail : LogicalTailZero LogicalSeed246.initial.registers := by
  intro i
  simpa only [LogicalSeed246.initial, Nat.add_comm] using LogicalSeed246.tail_zero i

/-- A complete literal target, not a finite-support-only tape observation. -/
def target : ZipConfig 244 :=
  { state := some ⟨87, by decide⟩, head := -5,
    left := true :: List.replicate @LEFT_PADDING@ false,
    right := List.replicate 181 false ++ [true] ++
      registerBits ([0, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0] ++ spares) ++
      List.replicate @RIGHT_PADDING@ false }

theorem target_zip :
    dispatchZip dispatchRotation244 (-5) @LEFT_PADDING@ @RIGHT_PADDING@ LogicalSeed246.initial 181 spares =
      target := by
  decide +kernel

/-- The theorem is independent of the eventual final checkpoint module. -/
theorem frame_of_target {binary : Config 244} (hz : ZipRep binary target) :
    DispatchFrame64 dispatchRotation244 binary LogicalSeed246.initial 181 spares := by
  refine ⟨by decide, seed_tail, @LEFT_PADDING@, @RIGHT_PADDING@, ?_⟩
  have hh : binary.head = -5 := hz.2.1
  rw [hh, target_zip]
  exact hz

theorem frame_of_checkpoint {binary : Config 244} {checkpoint : ZipConfig 244}
    (reached : ZipRep binary checkpoint) (shape : checkpoint = target) :
    DispatchFrame64 dispatchRotation244 binary LogicalSeed246.initial 181 spares := by
  rw [shape] at reached
  exact frame_of_target reached

theorem target_checkpoint :
    @FINAL_NAMESPACE@.checkpoint407931 = target := by
  decide +kernel

theorem bootstrap_frame :
    Rotation244Simulation.DispatchFrame64 dispatchRotation244
      (machineRotation244.run 407931) LogicalSeed246.initial 181 spares :=
  frame_of_checkpoint @FINAL_NAMESPACE@.bootstrap407931 target_checkpoint

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.BootstrapFrameRotation244

# Checked Rotation244 source tree and startup frame

Two Lean units connect the rotated source's exact tree to its program and the
407,931-step binary startup to the calibrated initial register frame. Their
actual source/audit runs pass **16 named probes and 19 typed callers**, with
zero warnings and only standard Lean axioms.

| Unit | Checked conclusion | Probes / callers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [TreeRotation244](../../Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/TreeRotation244.lean) | The actual rotated program unfolds to the literal tree for every fuel at least 51; exact arbitrary-pointer lookup and complete register-step semantics | 8 / 10 |
| [BootstrapFrameRotation244](../../Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/BootstrapFrameRotation244.lean) | The actual blank run at step 407,931 satisfies the runtime dispatch frame for `LogicalSeed246.initial` | 8 / 9 |

The tree retains the 203 stored DAG rows while recomputing every height after
rows 5 and 6 change. Row 4 becomes unreachable. Its complete unfolding has
6,459 leaves, 6,458 internal nodes, depth 51 and exactly one halt. Every generated
row equality and sufficient-fuel unfolding is checked by Lean. The audit also
checks the new increment and continue paths inside subtree `011`. The generator's
comparison with all retained logical sites is additional evidence; the Lean
theorem identifies the tree with `ProgramRotation244.program` itself.

The startup adapter uses the [complete blank prefix](rotation244_bootstrap.md)
and the checked runtime frame. It identifies the entire finite zipper at state
87 and head position −5, including left padding 9, right padding 0, 707 right
bits and 351 one cells. The logical seed has physical register values
`[0, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0]`, distance 181 and 167 nonempty spare registers of
value one. Both tape exteriors are zero. This establishes the actual
`DispatchFrame64` premise without replacing the tape by a finite observation.

The [tree record](results/tree-rotation244-verification.json) and
[frame record](results/rotation244-bootstrap-frame-verification.json) retain
actual source/audit output. The [publication record](results/rotation244-tree-frame-publication.json)
and [lossless text history](rotation244-tree-frame/history.json) preserve the
sources, typed audits, metadata, original guards, preparations, root-generated
literal data, draft frame inventory and disclosed author reviews. The independent
tree review is a source/emitter review; it does not claim another compilation.
Historical pending labels remain in their original source-only records.

Each source/audit pair used a shared 120-second limit, one thread, 4,096 MiB and
default proof limits. The tree reused six imported project providers and Init;
the frame selected 125 imported providers plus Init/Omega from three actual
parents. The BinaryPrefix246 record is an evidence carrier for LogicalSeed246;
its binary endpoint module is excluded from the frame's imports. Fresh objects
were captured before audit and all selected inputs/providers checked afterwards.
The [original guards and reproduction limits](rotation244-tree-frame/REPLAY.md)
retain their historical scratch paths. This publication contains no compiled
objects and does not claim a clean-checkout rebuild of cached dependencies.

Complete decoder-site coverage and the final binary composition remain separate
obligations. Once those are supplied, the checked
[Combined243/Rotation244 equivalence](combined243_simulation.md) transfers the
rotation endpoint to the 243-state machine. These two units do not by themselves
close that binary consistency endpoint or the internal PA proof. The original
Mira-Cult program, Jeff Ketchersid calibration, Andrew James Wade register
semantics, and prior ProveIt routing and rotation contributions retain their
attribution.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Emit exact TreeRotation244 and audit; root alone invokes this source writer.

No compiler, checker, simulator, subprocess or dependency build is invoked.
Finite DAG expansion below only constructs and compares literal syntax trees.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROUTING_SHA = '060a95566e6162b845b3ee734b4134aefeeb3e9c079de705c2d094ca9119ef0b'
ROTATION_SHA = '3bb25d3b5068dadd3f217b11c3fa10be0a86a5df04e3b50073413d03e8daa20a'
AUDIT_SHA = 'cc7eed2b9dc83db9cbb3c4e911d0ddd01f40f8900c063dfb1e5ba02a33a73382'
SITES_SHA = '3ee984818f0bdfd2c4daae72aeb14340572e34d73f5cdb5616b6d29d78fcd7f4'
PREFIX = 'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.TreeRotation244.'
PROBES = ['tree_eq_fuel', 'tree_eq', 'walk_eq_tree', 'step_eq_tree',
          'leaf_count', 'node_count', 'depth_eq', 'halt_count']


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def desc(path):
    return {'path': str(Path(path).resolve()), 'sha256': sha(path)}


def edge_text(edge):
    kind, value = edge
    return '.halt' if kind == 'halt' else f'(.{kind} {value})'


def tree_edge(edge):
    return f't{edge[1]:03}' if edge[0] == 'node' else f'(.leaf {edge_text(edge)})'


def child_proof(edge):
    return (f'(fun f hf => node{edge[1]:03}_eq f hf)' if edge[0] == 'node'
            else '(fun _ _ => rfl)')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    repo, output = args.repo.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
    assert not output.exists(), 'Use a fresh output directory.'
    assert not output.is_relative_to(repo), 'Scratch output must be outside the repository.'
    base = repo / 'Computability/BusyBeaver'
    routing = base / 'Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/ProgramRouting245.lean'
    rotation = base / 'Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/ProgramRotation244.lean'
    sites = base / 'Research/ZFC/candidate-rotation244/sites_logical.json'
    audit_template = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name('Audit-template.lean')
    for path, expected in [(routing, ROUTING_SHA), (rotation, ROTATION_SHA),
                           (sites, SITES_SHA), (audit_template, AUDIT_SHA)]:
        assert sha(path) == expected, (str(path), 'input changed')
    original = routing.read_text()
    matches = re.findall(r'^private def row(\d+) : Row := (.+)$', original, re.M)
    assert [int(index) for index, _ in matches] == list(range(203))
    rows = []
    for index_text, body in matches:
        tokens = re.findall(r'\.(node|inc|decnz|brk|cont|halt)(?: (\d+))?', body)
        assert len(tokens) == 2
        row = [(kind, int(value) if value else None) for kind, value in tokens]
        assert all(kind != 'node' or value < int(index_text) for kind, value in row)
        rows.append(row)
    assert rows[5] == [('decnz', 6), ('node', 4)]
    assert rows[6] == [('node', 5), ('inc', 0)]
    # These are the exact two branches in the pinned ProgramRotation244 source.
    rotated = rotation.read_text()
    assert 'if n = 5 then (.decnz 6, .cont 2)' in rotated
    assert 'else if n = 6 then (.inc 0, .node 5)' in rotated
    rows[5] = [('decnz', 6), ('cont', 2)]
    rows[6] = [('inc', 0), ('node', 5)]
    heights = []
    for row in rows:
        heights.append(1 + max(heights[value] if kind == 'node' else 0
                               for kind, value in row))
    leaves, reachable = [], set()
    names = {'inc': 'CI', 'decnz': 'CD', 'brk': 'CB', 'cont': 'CC', 'halt': 'CH'}

    def expand(edge, path):
        kind, value = edge
        if kind == 'node':
            reachable.add(value)
            expand(rows[value][0], path + '0')
            expand(rows[value][1], path + '1')
        else:
            leaves.append([path, names[kind], value])

    expand(('node', 202), '')
    assert leaves == json.loads(sites.read_text()), 'Complete ordered leaf certificate mismatch.'
    census = {'stored_rows': 203, 'reachable_rows': len(reachable),
              'leaves': len(leaves), 'internal_nodes': len(leaves) - 1,
              'depth': max(len(row[0]) for row in leaves),
              'halts': sum(row[1] == 'CH' for row in leaves)}
    assert census == dict(stored_rows=203, reachable_rows=202, leaves=6459,
                          internal_nodes=6458, depth=51, halts=1)
    assert set(range(203)) - reachable == {4}
    assert heights[202] == 51
    assert [row for row in leaves if row[0].startswith('011')] == [
        ['0110', 'CI', 0], ['01110', 'CD', 6], ['01111', 'CC', 2]]

    # Copy the already checked generic proof literally from its pinned source.
    helper = original.split('/-- Compose exact child unfoldings;', 1)[1]
    helper = '/-- Compose exact child unfoldings;' + helper.split('private def t000', 1)[0]
    assert helper.count('private theorem parent_eq') == 1
    header = '''import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProgramRotation244

/-!
Exact complete source tree for the rotated 244 program. The 203 stored rows
unfold to 6,459 leaves and 6,458 internal nodes, at depth 51, with one halt.
Row 4 remains stored but is unreachable after the row 5/6 rotation.
All fuel, pointer, register and complete leaf-effect contracts below use the
actual ProgramRotation244.program. Binary coverage and simulation are separate.

The parent_eq proof pattern and program literals are adapted from the checked
ProgramRouting245 source. The original Mira-Cult machine/calculus, Jeff
Ketchersid calibration, Andrew James Wade register semantics, and prior
ProveIt routing work retain their attribution. The rotation is from source 71.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.TreeRotation244
open RegisterPath RMBisim ProgramRotation244

'''
    lines = [header, helper]
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        left, right = row
        hleft = heights[left[1]] if left[0] == 'node' else 0
        hright = heights[right[1]] if right[0] == 'node' else 0
        lines.extend([
            f'private def t{index:03} : Tree := .node {tree_edge(left)} {tree_edge(right)}\n',
            f'private theorem row{index:03}_eq : program.nodes {index} = '
            f'({edge_text(left)}, {edge_text(right)}) := by decide +kernel\n',
            f'private theorem node{index:03}_eq (f : Nat) (hf : {heights[index]} ≤ f) : '
            f'toTree program f {index} = t{index:03} := by\n',
            f'  exact parent_eq (h₀ := {hleft}) (h₁ := {hright}) row{index:03}_eq\n',
            f'    {child_proof(left)} {child_proof(right)} f hf\n\n'])
    suffix = original.split('/-- The exact complete certificate tree, with shared subterms only. -/', 1)[1]
    suffix = '/-- The exact complete certificate tree, with shared subterms only. -/' + suffix
    suffix = suffix.replace('leafCount tree = 6460', 'leafCount tree = 6459')
    suffix = suffix.replace('nodeCount tree = 6459', 'nodeCount tree = 6458')
    suffix = suffix.replace('end TreeRouting245\nend SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC',
                            'end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.TreeRotation244')
    assert suffix.endswith('end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.TreeRotation244\n')
    lines.append(suffix)
    source = ''.join(lines)
    audit = audit_template.read_text()
    assert source.count('private theorem row') == source.count('private theorem node') == 203
    assert audit.count('#print axioms ') == 8 and len(re.findall(r'^example\b', audit, re.M)) == 10
    assert re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)$', audit, re.M) == [PREFIX + p for p in PROBES]
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    (output / 'TreeRotation244.lean').write_text(source)
    (output / 'Audit.lean').write_text(audit)
    literal_data = {'root': 202, 'rows': rows, 'heights': heights, 'census': census,
                    'unreachable_rows': [4], 'modified_rows': [5, 6],
                    'logical_sites': desc(sites), 'ordered_sites_equal': True}
    (output / 'tree-data.json').write_text(json.dumps(literal_data, indent=2) + '\n')
    inventory = {'status': 'GENERATED_NOT_BUILT', 'module': 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.TreeRotation244',
                 'generator': desc(__file__), 'inputs': [desc(p) for p in (routing, rotation, sites, audit_template)],
                 'source': desc(output / 'TreeRotation244.lean'), 'audit': desc(output / 'Audit.lean'),
                 'data': desc(output / 'tree-data.json'), 'direct_imports': ['BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProgramRotation244'],
                 'named_probes': [PREFIX + p for p in PROBES], 'typed_callers': 10,
                 'census': census, 'proof_commands': [], 'compiler_or_checker_invoked': False}
    (output / 'source-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(desc(output / 'source-inventory.json')))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
